producer_report.summary:
I added `later_similar_task`, which only counts a later landed job when its stored class_of_work is one of an accepted proposal's `applies_to`. Jobs of another class or with no class never count. Records alone cannot show it end to end, because the real records have no accepted proposal. Over the evidence snapshot the line would read `later similar task: not shown`. I did not run it there: `athena status --snapshot` does not print this line, so I counted proposals with Grep and found none.

- **Prevented:** needs at least three such later jobs (the repeat threshold that makes a proposal). It also needs no recurrence of the failure class on a later job, checked on every accepted proposal.
- **Detected earlier:** needs a recurrence in the proposal's classes at a stage earlier than the earliest stage among the introspections the proposal cites. I rank two stages: a verifier rejection is earlier than an owner fix after the result. `failed` and all other categories state no stage, so they give not shown. The doc comment gives the reason.
- **Anything else:** not shown, including no class, no later job, and a proposal that is pending, rejected or withdrawn.

`athena status` now prints a `later similar task:` line from a new `StatusView` field. The check is `later_similar_task_line` in status.rs and the print is in display.rs. `docs/spec.toml` OLY-10-03 names both functions, keeps owner Apollo and ends in `status: not shown`.

I added nine unit tests, a fixture test in status.rs and a CLI test that the printed line equals the view field. The CHANGELOG entry gives the one real-record result above and one example of each outcome, taken from the tests.

The full test suite, clippy and the policy scan all pass.

`records.rs` is unchanged, as the brief requires. The prior attempt's code was not in the base, so this is written fresh against the verifier's findings."

criteria_check.criterion: Test in crates/athena-data/src/records/introspection.rs: an accepted proposal plus enough later landed jobs of the same class_of_work with no recurrence gives prevented. Run `cargo test -p athena-data introspection`.

criteria_check.criterion: Test: a later landed job of a different class, or with no class, gives not shown; no later job gives not shown; a pending, rejected or pre-acceptance case gives not shown. Same run; the tests fail if the check ignores class.
criteria_check.evidence: These tests pass in the same run: introspection_later_jobs_of_another_class_or_no_class_are_not_shown, introspection_too_few_later_same_class_jobs_are_not_shown, introspection_jobs_before_the_acceptance_and_no_jobs_are_not_shown, introspection_a_pending_rejected_or_withdrawn_proposal_is_not_shown. The first one adds one extra same-class job and the answer flips to Prevented, so a check that ignores class would fail it. I did not run the tests against a class-ignoring version.

criteria_check.criterion: Test: a same-class recurrence at a stage the records show to be earlier gives detected earlier; same or later stage gives not shown; a recurrence on any accepted proposal blocks prevented. Same run.
criteria_check.evidence: These tests pass in the same run: introspection_a_recurrence_at_an_earlier_stage_is_detected_earlier, introspection_a_recurrence_at_the_same_or_a_later_or_an_unstated_stage_is_not_shown (covers failed and unstated categories), introspection_a_recurrence_on_a_job_of_another_class_is_not_shown_earlier, introspection_a_recurrence_on_any_accepted_proposal_blocks_prevented (tried with each proposal first).

Run `cargo test -p athena-core status` and `cargo test -p athena-cli status`.
criteria_check.evidence: In crates/athena-core/src/status.rs, the test the_later_similar_task_line_follows_the_class_of_the_later_landed_jobs builds Records with real Job and Outcome records (three code jobs, three docs jobs, three with no class) and requires `shown (prevented)` against `not shown`. Neither test puts a same-class and a different-class later job in one record set; each record set holds one class.

criteria_check.evidence: I read the doc comment on later_similar_task. It describes the applies_to class match, MIN_LATER_SAME_CLASS_JOBS, and the stage ranking by stage_rank with the reason a failed category has no rank. The false sentence about records carrying no class is not present.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry that records the measure's output over the real records with one example of each outcome (prevented, not prevented by different class, no later job); Grep shows it.

open_issues: The real-records output is `not shown`; no accepted proposal exists, so `prevented` over real records cannot be demonstrated yet.
The snapshot status view (athena status --snapshot) does not print the later similar task line. I did not change it because the snapshot code is outside the deliverables.

The stage ranking is deliberately narrow: rejected counts as stage 1 and owner-fix categories as stage 2. All other categories give no rank and never support detected earlier. A reviewer may want a richer ranking later.
mistakes: My first status.rs function was named landed_jobs, which clashed with an existing glob import; the build failed and I renamed it.
My first fixture test in status.rs tripped clippy field_reassign_with_default; I restructured it.
One search with a broad Glob listed 100 audience-rating records and wasted context.
learnings: The base commit did not contain later_similar_task, so I wrote it from scratch.
athena-core status.rs already has a landed_jobs imported from status/throughput.rs; I named mine landed_with_class to avoid the clash.
JobId derives Ord, with Bootstrap sorting before every request id, so `later` is a plain `>` on job ids.
The evidence snapshot holds no athena.defaults-proposal record outside quoted job briefs, so the real-record answer is not shown.
The tool policy bars grep, tail, head and cd in Bash, so I used the Grep tool for searches.
desires: A way to read the later similar task line over the real records. The snapshot status view does not print it, and no accepted proposal exists in the snapshot anyway.
